title: Giants clear cap space by restructuring Andrew Thomas's contract

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants clear cap space by restructuring Andrew Thomas's contract
sources.description: The Giants are near the bottom of the NFL in available cap space, but they've given themselves some room by restructuring the contract of one of their most expensive players.
